verdict.line: You lose trades before level 6 if you walker-harass into his Fury-fueled Q and W, but you win the lane by 9-13 once Mist Walkers and Maiden outscale his dash damage.

brief.thesis: Renekton's Fury passive (Reign of Anger) turns his Q (Cull the Meek) and W (Ruthless Predator) into free, repeatable burst that he can trigger whenever he chooses, while his E (Slice and Dice) gives him the only gap-close/escape in the lane. Yorick has no way to punish that window early, so OP.GG's own read is correct: pull lanes, farm, and stop feeding Mist Walkers into his Q for free value.

theirWindow.when: Fury over 50 and E off cooldown
theirWindow.what: At 50+ Fury his W (Ruthless Predator) upgrades to three slashes that shred shields and stun for 1.5 seconds instead of 0.75 — if he has E (Slice and Dice) up to dash in behind it, back off entirely rather than trade autos.

yourWindow.when: Right after he dashes with E
yourWindow.what: Slice and Dice is down for 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 seconds by rank once used. That's your window to land E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred and slow, then trade freely with Q (Last Rites) procs since he can't dash away or onto you.

start.why: The 46.6% win rate over 680 games edges out Doran's Helm here because the sustained HP5 and damage reduction on hit directly answers Renekton's repeated Q/W poke instead of just trading mana for sustain.

boots.why: 79.3% pick rate and 48.7% win rate — the flat damage reduction on his autos and Q swings matters more than magic resist since every point of his kit is physical.

core.why: Gives you the stats to actually threaten a fight once Maiden and walkers are online, and it's the first item in the strongest measured path (70% win rate over 40 games).
The armor shred stacks with your E (Mourning Mist) debuff, letting your empowered autos punch through Renekton's building tankiness.
Cooldown reduction accelerates your Q (Last Rites) and E resets, which is how you out-trade his Fury windows in extended skirmishes.

situational.when: he's snowballed and still looking to all-in with his empowered W stun chain
the lane has gone to a farm-only stalemate and you want siege power to win the split push
you need the slow on top of armor shred to lock him down in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustain and permanent HP growth let you absorb his early Fury-fueled trades without losing the lane, and the bonus health carries directly into your midgame teamfight presence.

summoners.why: Teleport is the most-run second spell here (50.2% pick) because the matchup is defensive by design — you're farming through his early advantage, so Teleport lets you reset safely or help other lanes instead of forcing a fight you lose.

playing.title: Stop walker-feeding him free Q value
playing.detail: His Q (Cull the Meek) hits everyone around him including your Mist Walkers, so sending them in before you have numbers just hands him sustain. Farm minions with Q (Last Rites) procs instead.

playing.title: Track his Fury, not just his cooldowns
playing.detail: At 50+ Fury his W becomes a three-hit, 1.5-second stun that destroys shields. Disengage rather than trade autos when you see him sitting on a full bar.

playing.title: Punish the dash, not the dasher
playing.detail: E (Slice and Dice) is his only gap-close and it's down for up to 16 seconds after use. That's when you commit your own E (Mourning Mist) and Q procs.

playing.title: Wall, don't fight, during his all-in window
playing.detail: W (Dark Procession) at 600 range can block his E dash path or cut him off from reinforcements rather than trying to out-trade his burst directly.

playing.title: Hold R for a committed duel
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles is down for 160/130/100/100/100 seconds — don't summon Maiden just to farm faster, save it for a fight you can actually win and let it raise walkers off the kill.

playing.title: Use Teleport to deny his solo-kill angle
playing.detail: Since he has the solo-kill advantage, playing for safe resets and side-lane impact with Teleport is higher value than contesting all-in windows you lose.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Renekton will have the upper hand as his (E) allows him to deal damage when he pleases, not to mention that his (Q) can get rid of Mist Walkers easily. Pull lanes and focus on farming instead.
